sentence: El cel no està clar avui.
ipa: əl ˈsɛl ˈno sˈta ˈklar ˈaβuj
gloss_en: The sky is not clear today.
notes: Atonic ⟨a/e⟩→[ə] reduction 'el','avui' and stressed open-mid ⟨e⟩ [ˈsɛl] per recasens1996; word-final ⟨t⟩ devoicing 'està' per wheeler2005. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: ⟨està⟩ loses its initial atonic [ə] after the vowel-final ⟨no⟩, giving [ˈno ˈsta].

sentence: Aquesta tarda plou sobre la ciutat.
ipa: əˈkɛstə ˈtarðə ˈplɔw ˈsɔβɾə lə siwˈtat
gloss_en: This afternoon it is raining over the city.
notes: Central atonic ⟨e/a⟩→[ə] 'aquesta','tarda','sobre' and open-mid ⟨o⟩ [ˈplɔw],[ˈsɔβɾə] per recasens1996; ⟨d⟩ spirantised to [ð] 'tarda' per wheeler2005.

sentence: Les cases velles tenen finestres grosses.
ipa: ləs ˈkazəz ˈβɛʎəs ˈtɛnəm fiˈnɛstɾəz ˈɣɾɔsəs
gloss_en: The old houses have big windows.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'velles' per wheeler2005; final ⟨s⟩ voicing to [z] before a voiced onset 'cases velles','finestres grosses' (sandhi) per recasens1996.

sentence: On és la clau del cotxe?
ipa: ˈon ˈez lə ˈklaw ðəl ˈkotʃə
gloss_en: Where is the car key?
notes: Copula final ⟨s⟩ voiced [z] before vowel 'és la' and atonic reduction 'del cotxe' [ˈkotʃə] per recasens1996; ⟨tx⟩ affricate [tʃ] per wheeler2005.

sentence: El meu germà viu a prop de la plaça.
ipa: əl ˈmew ʒərˈma ˈβiw ə ˈpɾɔb də lə ˈplasə
gloss_en: My brother lives near the square.
notes: Voiced prepalatal ⟨g⟩ [ʒ] 'germà' and open-mid [ˈpɾɔb] per wheeler2005; the possessive 'meu' is CLOSE [ˈmew] (closed-class, per dcvb) and no longer carries this row's open_mid axis; final ⟨p⟩ voiced [b] in 'prop de' by regressive assimilation (sandhi) per recasens1996.

sentence: La reunió és demà a les tres.
ipa: lə rəwniˈo ˈez ðəˈma ə ləs ˈtɾɛs
gloss_en: The meeting is tomorrow at three.
notes: Copula ⟨s⟩ voiced [z] before vowel 'és demà' and open-mid [ˈtɾɛs] per recasens1996; atonic reduction 'la reunió','les' per wheeler2005.

sentence: Vine de seguida i tanca la porta.
ipa: ˈbinə ðə səˈɣiðə j ˈtaŋkə lə ˈpɔrtə
gloss_en: Come at once and shut the door.
notes: Velar nasal [ŋ] before ⟨c⟩ 'tanca' and open-mid ⟨o⟩ [ˈpɔrtə] per wheeler2005; atonic ⟨e/a⟩→[ə] 'vine','de seguida' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the bare conjunction ⟨i⟩ glides to [j] between vowels.

sentence: Quinze taronges i dotze pomes valen deu euros.
ipa: ˈkinzə təˈɾɔɲʒəz i ˈðɔdzə ˈpɔməz ˈβalən ˈdɛw ˈɛwɾus
gloss_en: Fifteen oranges and twelve apples cost ten euros.
notes: Palatal nasal ⟨ny⟩ [ɲ] 'taronges' realised in the ⟨ronge⟩ cluster and voiced affricate ⟨tz/dz⟩ 'dotze' per wheeler2005; atonic final ⟨o⟩→[u] 'euros' [ˈɛwɾus] per recasens1996.

sentence: El gos corre per la vora del riu.
ipa: əl ˈɣos ˈkorə pər lə ˈβɔɾə ðəl ˈriw
gloss_en: The dog runs along the riverbank.
notes: Trill ⟨rr⟩ [r] 'corre' against tap ⟨r⟩ [ɾ] 'vora' and open-mid [ˈkɔrə],[ˈβɔɾə] per recasens1996; atonic reduction 'el gos','del riu' per wheeler2005.

sentence: La senyora menja pa amb tomàquet.
ipa: lə səˈɲɔɾə ˈmɛɲʒə ˈpa əm tuˈmakət
gloss_en: The lady eats bread with tomato.
notes: Palatal nasal ⟨ny⟩ [ɲ] 'senyora','menja' per wheeler2005; atonic ⟨o⟩→[u] 'tomàquet' [tuˈmakət] and final ⟨b⟩→[m] assimilation 'amb' per recasens1996.

sentence: Aquell noi jove treballa a la fàbrica.
ipa: əˈkɛʎ ˈnɔj ˈʒɔβə tɾəˈβaʎ ə lə ˈfaβɾikə
gloss_en: That young lad works at the factory.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'aquell','treballa' and voiced prepalatal ⟨j⟩ [ʒ] 'jove' per wheeler2005; open-mid ⟨o⟩ [ˈʒɔβə] per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨treballa⟩ elides before ⟨a⟩, giving [tɾəˈβaʎ ə].

sentence: No crec que faci sol aquesta setmana.
ipa: ˈno ˈkɾɛk kə ˈfasi ˈsɔl əˈkɛstə sətˈmanə
gloss_en: I do not think it will be sunny this week.
notes: Open-mid ⟨o⟩ [ˈsɔl] and stressed [ˈkɾɛk] per recasens1996; atonic ⟨e/a⟩→[ə] 'que','aquesta','setmana' per wheeler2005.

sentence: La muntanya és plena de neu enguany.
ipa: lə munˈtəɲ ˈes ˈplɛnə ðə ˈnɛw ənˈɡwaɲ
gloss_en: The mountain is full of snow this year.
notes: Palatal nasal ⟨ny⟩ [ɲ] 'muntanya','enguany' and open-mid [ˈplɛnə],[ˈnɛw] per wheeler2005; atonic reduction 'la','de' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨muntanya⟩ elides before ⟨és⟩, giving [muˈntəɲ ˈes].

sentence: Els nens petits juguen al pati de l'escola.
ipa: əlz ˈnɛns pəˈtidz ˈʒuɣən əl ˈpati ðə ləsˈkɔlə
gloss_en: The little children play in the schoolyard.
notes: Voiced prepalatal ⟨j⟩ [ʒ] 'juguen' and final ⟨ts⟩ voiced [dz] 'petits' before vowel (sandhi) per wheeler2005; atonic ⟨e/a⟩→[ə] and elision 'de l'escola' per recasens1996.

sentence: Puja les escales i obre la finestra.
ipa: ˈpuʒə ləz əsˈkaləz j ˈɔβɾə lə fiˈnɛstɾə
gloss_en: Go up the stairs and open the window.
notes: Voiced prepalatal ⟨j⟩ [ʒ] 'puja' and open-mid [ˈɔβɾə],[fiˈnɛstɾə] per wheeler2005; final ⟨s⟩ voiced [z] before vowel 'les escales' (sandhi) per recasens1996.

sentence: Quanta gent ha vingut a la festa?
ipa: ˈkwantə ˈʒen ˈa βinˈɡut ə lə ˈfɛstə
gloss_en: How many people have come to the party?
notes: Voiced prepalatal ⟨g⟩ [ʒ] 'gent' and open-mid [ˈfɛstə] per wheeler2005; 'gent' is CLOSE [ˈʒen] — coda /nt/ is not one of Fabra's (1906) opening contexts (mascaro2009 §1) — and no longer carries this row's open_mid axis; final ⟨t⟩ deletion in the ⟨nt⟩ coda 'gent' per recasens1996.

sentence: El pont de fusta travessa el torrent.
ipa: əl ˈpɔn də ˈfustə tɾəˈβɛs əl tuˈren
gloss_en: The wooden bridge crosses the stream.
notes: Trill ⟨rr⟩ [r] 'torrent' and open-mid [ˈpɔn],[tɾəˈβɛs] per recasens1996; final ⟨t⟩ deletion 'pont','torrent' per wheeler2005. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨travessa⟩ elides before ⟨el⟩, giving [tɾəˈβɛs əl].

sentence: Sento la pluja caure damunt les teulades.
ipa: ˈsentu lə ˈpluʒə ˈkawɾə ðəˈmun ləs təwˈlaðəs
gloss_en: I hear the rain falling on the roofs.
notes: Voiced prepalatal ⟨j⟩ [ʒ] 'pluja' with atonic final ⟨o⟩→[u] per recasens1996; atonic reduction 'damunt les teulades' per wheeler2005. 'Sento' is CLOSE [ˈsentu]: coda /nt/ is not one of Fabra's (1906) opening contexts for a stressed front mid vowel (mascaro2009 §1), so this row no longer exercises the open_mid axis and no longer claims to.

sentence: Bon dia, com va la vida per aquí?
ipa: ˈbɔn ˈdiə kum ˈba lə ˈβiðə pər əˈki
gloss_en: Good morning, how is life around here?
notes: Open-mid ⟨o⟩ [ˈbɔn],[ˈkɔm] and stressed hiatus 'dia' [ˈdiə] per recasens1996; ⟨v⟩ betacism to [β] 'vida' and tap 'per' per wheeler2005.

sentence: La meva filla porta un vestit vermell.
ipa: lə ˈmeβə ˈfiʎə ˈpɔrtə wm bəsˈtid bərˈmɛʎ
gloss_en: My daughter is wearing a red dress.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'filla' and ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'vermell' with open-mid [bəˈrmɛʎ] per wheeler2005; atonic ⟨e⟩→[ə] 'meva','vestit' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: ⟨un⟩ glides to [wm] after the vowel-final ⟨porta⟩, the nasal assimilating to the following labial.
